reviews.author: Kabir Mehra
reviews.body: Agar unique aur elegant jewellery pasand hai to ye pendant ek perfect choice lagta hai. Iska design bahut charming aur fashionable hai.

reviews.author: Rudra Malhotra
reviews.body: Tortoise inspired design bahut interesting aur beautiful laga. Iska style different hai aur jewellery collection mein ek special place bana sakta hai.

reviews.author: Devansh Jain
reviews.body: Golden finish bahut smooth aur attractive lagti hai. Pendant ka overall appearance dekhkar premium quality ka feel aata hai.🎉

reviews.author: Advait Singh
reviews.body: Ye pendant daily styling ke liye bhi ek beautiful option lagta hai. Simple outfits ke saath bhi ye ek classy touch add karta hai aur look ko complete banata hai.🥰

sections.text:

 ✨ 24K gold tone plated brass pendant with green shell detailing for a premium earthy look

sections.heading: How to wear ?
sections.text:
Wear the Golden Tortoise Crystal Pendant and let it sit comfortably near your collarbone.
For daily styling, pair it with shirts, T-shirts, tops, kurtis, or simple dresses. The green shell detail adds a fresh highlight, while the gold tone keeps the look clean and premium.
For work, business meetings, or goal-focused days, wear it as a reminder of patience, stability, confidence, and steady growth.
For festive or evening looks, style it with gold-tone earrings, a slim bracelet, or minimal rings for a more polished appearance.
You can also wear it with the intention of attracting wealth, abundance, protection, and long-term success through the Pyrite crystal infused on the backside.

 Product Description
 
 

 
 
 

 

 

 
 
 This pendant has a calm kind of confidence.

The Golden Tortoise Crystal Pendant is designed for people who like jewellery that feels steady, meaningful, and quietly premium. The tortoise shape brings a sense of patience, protection, and long-term stability, while the green shell detailing adds a fresh, grounded look to the design.

Made with brass and finished in 24K gold tone plating, the pendant carries a warm golden shine without looking too heavy. The shell pattern gives it character, while the sparkling accents make it polished enough for both everyday wear and special occasions.

On the backside, the pendant is infused with resin and Pyrite crystal. Pyrite is associated with wealth, confidence, abundance, success, and strong willpower, making this piece a beautiful reminder to stay focused on steady and lasting growth.

A pendant for those who believe real success is not rushed—it is built with patience, balance, and steady energy.

Note: This product includes the pendant only. Chain is not included.

sections.text:
collapsible-row-list-item__label">
 

 
 FAQ
 
 

 
 
 

 

 

 
 
 Q1. What does the Golden Tortoise Crystal Pendant represent?

The tortoise represents stability, patience, protection, balance, and steady growth in life.

Q2. What is the pendant made of?

The pendant is made of brass with a 24K gold tone plated finish.

Q3. Does this pendant come with a chain?

Yes, it comes with a golden veloré chain made of stainless steel, so it is ready to wear.

Q4. Which crystal is infused in this pendant?

The backside of the pendant is infused with Pyrite crystal, known for wealth, abundance, confidence, success, and strong willpower.

Q5. Is resin used in this pendant?

Yes, resin is infused on the backside to give the pendant a smooth, refined, and handcrafted finish.

Q6. Can I wear it daily?

Yes, it is suitable for daily wear and can be styled with casual outfits, office looks, ethnic wear, festive looks, or evening styling.

Q7. Who should wear this pendant?

Anyone who connects with stability, prosperity, protection, confidence, and long-term growth can wear it.

Q8. Is this pendant good for gifting?

Yes, it makes a meaningful gift for someone starting a new career, business, financial goal, or important life phase.

Q9. How should I care for it?

Keep it away from water, perfume, sweat, and harsh chemicals. Store it in a dry pouch or jewellery box after use to maintain its shine.
